title: unified-rollouts: proactive canary + shadow autorollback workflow improvements
author: Jordan Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve rollout resilience by adding proactive canary probing for shadowed traffic and a coordinated autorollback workflow across canary/A-B/shadow modes. Operators reported delayed detection when shadow traffic only surfaced regressions after canary weight increased. This PR adds a proactive probing step that exercises shadowed variants with representative requests, surfaces early telemetry mismatches to the autorollback engine, and tightens safety guards for metric quorums.

Summary of changes: - Add `proactive_probing` stage to rollout pipelines: a lightweight, configurable probing run against shadow variants before increasing canary weight. - Integrate probing results into the existing AutorollbackEngine (metric thresholds, quorum rules). - New telemetry events and dashboard facets: rollout.probe.start/finish, rollout.probe.mismatch, rollout.probe.quorum. - E2E test harness updates and new integration tests that simulate divergence under shadow traffic and assert rollback occurs before canary weight > 10%. - Backwards-compatible toggles: feature flag `proactive_probing_enabled` (off by default), and conservative defaults for thresholds.

Checklist: - [x] Add proactive probing stage and orchestration wiring
- [x] AutorollbackEngine: consume probe results and evaluate composite metrics
- [x] Telemetry + dashboards (console): probe events + alerting hook
- [x] Unit + integration tests (CI)
- [x] Migration notes and documentation updates in redwood-docs

Testing and verification: Local unit tests for AutorollbackEngine logic and quorum computation. Integration tests run in perf-canary harness and CI with mocked model divergence signals. CI run shows full passing matrix (unit/integration/e2e). Deployed to staging with feature flag enabled; exercised with canary pipeline using a synthetic divergence dataset; autorollback triggered at probing stage and prevented canary promotion.

Rollout plan: Merge to main -> ship behind feature flag -> enable in staging for 48h -> enable gradual opt-in for customers on rollout pipelines -> monitor `rollout.probe.mismatch` and `autorollback.triggered` metrics.

Backward compatibility: Default feature flag is off. Existing rollout pipelines behave unchanged unless flag enabled. No changes to stored rollout config formats (fields are optional).

Follow-ups: - Add adaptive probe selection using historical request distributions (ENG-2421) - Auto-tune quorum thresholds by traffic volume (ENG-2432) - Documentation how-to with examples for customers (DOC-517)

Notes: This PR focuses on orchestration and safety logic; it does not change serving runtime request path.

discussion:
Avery Chen: Left a few nits around quorum math and edge cases when traffic volume is extremely low.

Jordan Patel: Addressed the quorum math by adding a minimum sample cap and unit tests (quorum_test.go). Also added config comments to clarify defaults.

Marcos Ruiz: Can we assert that the probing runner does not add significant latency to the orchestrator? Suggest running probes asynchronously and rate-limited.

Jordan Patel: Probes run in a separate worker pool with a bounded concurrency (default=5). Added observability to track probe latency distribution.

Priya Natarajan: Confirmed e2e regression test reproduces rollback within probing stage. Approved after test additions.

Daniel Kim: Verified dashboards and CI green. Approved and requested squash-merge with a brief changelog entry.
release_notes: Add optional proactive probing stage to rollout pipelines to detect regressions in shadowed variants early and prevent unsafe canary promotions. Ship behind feature flag `proactive_probing_enabled`.
e2e_results: Integration tests in perf-canary show autorollback triggered during probe stage for synthetic divergence scenario. CI matrix: all jobs passed. Staging rollout with flag on observed expected probe events and no regressions in production.
observability_notes: New metrics: rollout_probe_requests, rollout_probe_mismatches, rollout_probe_quorum_success. Dashboard added under Console -> Rollouts -> Probes. Recommended alerts: >5 mismatches in 5m window for a single rollout variant.
migration_notes: No mandatory migration. New fields are optional. To enable: set feature flag and optionally configure probe thresholds in rollout config.
